title: THE APPEARANCE SCREEN
why: His order of 2026-10-15: the appearance screen redone in the game UI style, in the same window. Five tabs over the racks, HEAD, BODY, PACK, COLOURS and SETS, replace the one long wall of racks (every rack is on exactly one tab, and a slot on the left jumps to its own tab). The picture of your operator is bigger and turns slowly, facing all the way round while the window is open, so you see the pack, the pads and the face from every side. Every tile wears a bar in its rarity colour, from what it takes to earn it (grey for owned from the start, then green, blue, purple and gold for a Warden kill or the reward board), a scheme tile shows its three colours, and a locked tile still says in capitals how to earn it. Cosmetic only.
now: FASHION has tabs for head, body, pack, colours and sets, a bigger turning picture, and rarity bars.
